name: gdg-challenges
description: GDG Challenges — daily & weekly technical challenge platform (monorepo root)

scripts.dev: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --parallel --filter "./apps/*" run dev
scripts.dev:backend: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter @gdg/backend run dev
scripts.dev:frontend: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter @gdg/frontend run dev
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm -r run typecheck

scriptNotes.dev: Builds @gdg/shared, then runs frontend and backend development servers together.
scriptNotes.dev:backend: Builds @gdg/shared, then starts only the Fastify backend.
scriptNotes.dev:frontend: Builds @gdg/shared, then starts only the Vite frontend.
scriptNotes.db:up: Starts the optional local Docker PostgreSQL container; it does not affect Supabase.
scriptNotes.db:down: Stops the local Docker PostgreSQL container while preserving its volume; it is a no-op when Docker is unavailable.
scriptNotes.db:reset: Destructively recreates the local Docker database volume and applies local migrations.
scriptNotes.db:setup: Applies pending Drizzle migrations to the database in DATABASE_URL, such as Supabase.
scriptNotes.db:local-setup: Starts local Docker PostgreSQL and applies migrations using the local connection string.
scriptNotes.db:local-seed: Loads development seed data into local Docker PostgreSQL, never the DATABASE_URL database.
scriptNotes.db:local-up: Alias for starting the optional local Docker PostgreSQL container.
scriptNotes.db:local-down: Alias for stopping the optional local Docker PostgreSQL container.
scriptNotes.db:local-reset: Alias for destructively recreating the local Docker PostgreSQL database.
scriptNotes.db:generate: Generates a Drizzle migration from backend *.table.ts changes; run from the repository root and review the generated files.
scriptNotes.db:migrate: Applies pending Drizzle migrations to DATABASE_URL.
scriptNotes.db:seed: Loads development seed data into DATABASE_URL; run only on an empty development database.
scriptNotes.db:clear: Deletes development rows from DATABASE_URL only when --confirm is supplied; never use on production or shared data without approval.
scriptNotes.build: Builds every workspace package in dependency order.
scriptNotes.build:shared: Builds @gdg/shared so its runtime exports and declarations are available to apps.
scriptNotes.typecheck: Builds @gdg/shared and type-checks every workspace without emitting app JavaScript.
scriptNotes.clean: Removes generated build output from every workspace package.
